The Role

We are hiring a Software Engineer who will single-handedly analyse, design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack operational systems serving Chinese clients across semiconductor, MCU, and cross-border business domains. This is not a narrowly scoped position — the successful candidate must independently manage the complete lifecycle of multiple concurrent software systems, from requirements gathering with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders through to production deployment on China-compliant infrastructure.

The role requires a rare combination of full-stack software engineering, hands-on Linux server administration, working familiarity with IC design and EDA tool environments, and the ability to operate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese across technical, business, and compliance contexts. The candidate will be the primary technical owner of all systems and must be capable of working without supervision across all layers of the stack and across all stages of delivery.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack web applications end-to-end — including React or Vue front-end interfaces, Python-based backend services, relational databases, RESTful APIs, authentication systems, and administrative dashboards — within a single-engineer ownership model.
- Build and maintain internal tools, management systems, workflow dashboards, and client-facing operational platforms for cross-border Chinese SMEs, semiconductor companies, and engineering teams, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms (WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-specific cloud APIs) using Chinese-language API documentation.
- Develop and maintain software tools, scripts, and workflow automation systems that support IC design operations, including DFT workflows, Verilog-based digital logic design, verification pipelines, and EDA tool environments (Cadence and Synopsys) — covering environment configuration, licence server management, and build-flow automation.
- Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain applications on Linux-based server environments across Mainland China and international infrastructure, including ICP-filed domains, China-based hosting, cross-border DNS and CDN configuration, reverse proxy setup (Nginx), and environment-specific application configuration. Troubleshoot infrastructure issues specific to China-facing deployments, including Great Firewall constraints and dual-environment architectures.
- Identify technology limitations, performance bottlenecks, and process gaps across existing systems, then independently design, implement, and document improvements — maintaining technical documentation, API references, deployment runbooks, and operational procedures in both English and Chinese.
- Analyse operational metrics, system performance data, user feedback, and error reports to drive continuous improvement across all systems under management.
- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for bilingual teams, Chinese clients, and stakeholders across China, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Australia, conducting requirements gathering and technical communication in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Technical Requirements

Required

- Hands-on experience in full-stack web development, with demonstrated ability to independently deliver complete systems from front-end to backend to deployment.
- Strong proficiency in Python as a primary backend language, with production experience in Django, Flask, or FastAPI for building database-backed web applications and API services.
- Production experience developing front-end interfaces using React or Vue (not merely prototyping), including state management, component architecture, API integration, and responsive design.
- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining internal tools, admin panels, operational dashboards, and workflow management platforms for business users.
- Solid understanding of RESTful API design, relational database modelling (PostgreSQL or MySQL), authentication and authorisation systems, third-party API integration, and system-to-system communication patterns.
- Hands-on Linux server administration experience, including setup, configuration, application deployment, Nginx reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS management, firewall rules, log management, cron jobs, process supervision, and production troubleshooting — not merely development on Linux.
- Practical experience with Docker containerisation, CI/CD pipeline configuration, and cloud or hybrid server deployment environments.
- Working knowledge of digital IC design workflows, including an understanding of DFT (Design for Test) concepts, Verilog HDL, digital logic design, synthesis, and verification processes — sufficient to develop, configure, and maintain software tools and workflow integrations that support IC design engineering teams.
- Direct experience working with EDA tool environments, specifically Cadence and/or Synopsys toolchains, including at least one of: tool installation and environment configuration, licence server setup and management, build-flow scripting and automation, or integration of EDA tools into broader engineering workflow platforms.
- Familiarity with ARM Cortex and/or RISC-V processor architectures and MCU-based development workflows, with sufficient understanding to build and maintain software systems that support semiconductor engineering and production operations.
- Demonstrated experience with Mainland China infrastructure and compliance requirements, including ICP filing processes, China-based hosting configuration, China-accessible domain and DNS setup, and deployment of applications that function reliably behind the Great Firewall.
- Experience building operational software systems for Chinese businesses, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms, services, or APIs (e.g., WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-based cloud providers), with the ability to independently read and implement from Chinese-language technical documentation.

Preferred

- Experience developing automation scripts, engineering workflow tools, internal development platforms, or integration layers specifically for semiconductor or IC design teams in China.
- Understanding of MCU, semiconductor, embedded systems, or IC design industries in Greater China and broader Asia, particularly where software platforms support engineering, production, or client delivery workflows.
- Experience with software performance optimisation, security hardening, monitoring and alerting systems, and deployment automation for production environments operating across multiple jurisdictions.
- Familiarity with cross-border data handling, dual-environment deployment architectures (China/international), and the operational constraints of running software services that must function in both mainland Chinese and international network environments simultaneously.
- Experience working in small teams or as a sole technical operator with full ownership of systems from requirements through to production support.

Language & Communication

- Proficient in English.
- Fluent Mandarin Chinese, both spoken and written, is required.
- Ability to communicate technical requirements, system issues, software specifications, and deployment matters with Chinese clients and Mandarin-speaking stakeholders.
- Ability to read and interpret Chinese platform documentation, API documentation, compliance materials, and technical communication; draft technical communications in Chinese for mainland stakeholders; and navigate Chinese-language developer resources, forums, and support channels without assistance.

JZZEE PTY LTD T/A Khan Curry Hut  
Address: 97/99 Ryrie St, Geelong VIC 3220  
Position: Full Time Chef  
Salary: $85,000 plus Superannuation  

Khan Curry Hut is seeking an experienced and passionate Full Time Chef to join our busy 
and growing team in Geelong. This is a full-time position offering a competitive salary and 
long-term career opportunities for the right candidate. 

Key Duties and Responsibilities 
•	Prepare, cook, and present a wide variety of authentic Indian, Pakistani, and Nepalese 
curries, ensuring traditional recipes, flavours and cooking techniques are maintained. 
•	Specialise in the preparation of regional curry dishes, including butter chicken, chicken 
tikka masala, rogan josh, karahi, korma, vindaloo, madras, jalfrezi, biryani, nihari, 
haleem, saag, dal, momo curry, goat curry, and other traditional specialties. 
•	Prepare, cook, and present a variety of authentic tandoori dishes, including naan bread, 
kebabs, tikka, seekh kebabs, and other traditional Indian specialties. 
•	Prepare and blend traditional spice mixes (masalas), marinades, curry bases, and 
sauces using authentic ingredients and cooking methods. 
•	Regulate temperatures of tandoor ovens, stoves, grills, ovens, and other cooking 
equipment to achieve consistent cooking quality. 
•	Develop, plan, and update menus by introducing new regional Indian, Pakistani, and 
•	Nepalese dishes, seasonal specials, and chef's recommendations. 
•	Standardise recipes and portion sizes to ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and 
food cost control. 
•	Estimate food and labour costs and assist in managing kitchen budgets and operational 
expenses. 
•	Monitor the quality of food throughout preparation, cooking, and presentation to ensure 
high standards are consistently maintained. 
•	Ensure curries, gravies, sauces, and accompaniments are prepared fresh daily and 
meet established quality standards. 
•	Supervise, train, and coordinate kitchen staff in authentic curry preparation techniques, 
food presentation, and safe kitchen practices. 
•	Delegate kitchen tasks effectively to ensure smooth and efficient operations during busy 
service periods. 
•	Maintain high standards of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and workplace health and 
safety (WHS/OH&S) compliance. 
•	Inspect raw ingredients for freshness and quality before preparation and reject 
substandard products. 
•	Manage stock levels, order supplies, monitor inventory, and liaise with suppliers to 
ensure the availability of quality spices, meats, vegetables, and specialty ingredients. 
•	Minimise food waste through effective stock rotation, portion control, and inventory 
management. 
•	Collaborate with restaurant management on menu planning, food costing, pricing 
strategies, and kitchen operations. 
•	Cater for customer dietary requirements and preferences, including vegetarian, vegan, 
halal, gluten-free, and mild or extra-spicy curry options where appropriate. 
•	Plate and garnish dishes to ensure they meet the restaurant's presentation standards 
before service. 
•	Maintain a clean, organised, and efficient kitchen, ensuring proper storage, handling, 
and labelling of food in accordance with food safety regulations. 
•	Monitor customer feedback and make improvements to recipes and menu offerings to 
enhance customer satisfaction. 
•	Assist in developing and implementing standard operating procedures to improve 
kitchen productivity and maintain consistent food quality. 

Qualification and Experience:  
•	Possess excellent relevant post-secondary hospitality (cooking) qualifications, to at least 
Diploma level.  
•	Have at least three years of professional experience or more preferred in tandoor.  
•	Are available across the working week including weekends and Public Holidays.  
•	Strong knowledge of Indian cuisine, cooking techniques, and kitchen management.  
•	Offer proven ability to prioritise, set goals and have the determination to achieve them.  
•	Possess a thorough understanding of food safety and HACCP.  
•	Understand cost control, time management, prioritization, and cost-efficient procurement 
practices.  
•	Cooking tandoor dishes skills is an advantage.  
•	Passion for food and commitment to high standards of quality and hygiene.  
•	Strict compliance towards food safety  


How to apply:

Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

Business: Domino’s Pizza Sutherland
Address: 55B Eton Street, Sutherland NSW 2232
Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing
Salary: AUD $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation
About the Business
Domino’s Pizza Sutherland operates as a fast-paced, customer-focused quick service restaurant within the Domino’s Australia network. The store provides high-volume takeaway, delivery, and in-store customer services while maintaining compliance with Domino’s national operational systems, food safety standards, and franchise requirements. The business is committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences through operational excellence, efficient service delivery, strong team leadership, and consistent adherence to Domino’s brand standards.
Serving the Sutherland Shire community and surrounding areas, Domino’s Pizza Sutherland operates in a dynamic and high-volume environment that requires effective operational management, workforce coordination, inventory control, and customer service leadership to ensure ongoing business success.
 
Position Overview
The Retail Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management of Domino’s Pizza Sutherland's daily operations, ensuring efficient store performance, strong financial outcomes, exceptional customer service, and effective team leadership. The role requires hands-on operational involvement within a fast-paced quick service restaurant environment and accountability for workforce management, compliance, inventory control, and operational excellence in accordance with Domino’s Australia policies and procedures.
This is a senior operational role suited to an experienced retail or hospitality professional who thrives in a structured, performance-driven environment and possesses strong leadership and organisational capabilities.
 
Key Responsibilities
Store Operations & Performance
•	Plan, coordinate, and manage daily store operations to achieve sales, productivity, and customer service targets.
•	Ensure compliance with Domino's operational procedures, food safety requirements, workplace health and safety obligations, and franchise standards.
•	Monitor key operational performance indicators including labour costs, food costs, wastage levels, sales performance, and profitability.
•	Coordinate workflow during peak trading periods to maintain service efficiency and customer satisfaction.
•	Identify opportunities to improve operational processes and service delivery standards.
People Leadership & Team Management
•	Recruit, train, roster, supervise, and motivate store employees including shift supervisors, pizza makers, customer service staff, and delivery drivers.
•	Provide ongoing coaching, performance management, and skills development consistent with Domino's training systems and operational expectations.
•	Foster a positive and collaborative workplace culture that promotes accountability, teamwork, and operational excellence.
•	Monitor employee performance and ensure adequate staffing levels are maintained throughout trading hours.
•	Promote compliance with workplace policies and ensure adherence to employment obligations.
Customer Experience & Brand Standards
•	Oversee customer service delivery across takeaway, delivery, and in-store service channels.
•	Resolve customer complaints and service issues promptly and professionally to maintain customer satisfaction and brand reputation.
•	Maintain high standards of store presentation, cleanliness, and food quality at all times.
•	Ensure all products are prepared and delivered in accordance with Domino's quality and service standards.
•	Support the implementation of customer service initiatives aimed at enhancing the overall customer experience.
Stock Management & Cost Control
•	Manage inventory levels, supplier orders, stock deliveries, and stock rotation procedures.
•	Conduct regular stocktakes and monitor food cost variances, wastage levels, and inventory usage.
•	Implement effective cost control measures to support profitability objectives.
•	Ensure store equipment, POS systems, and operational assets are maintained and functioning efficiently.
•	Coordinate with suppliers and internal support teams regarding operational requirements when necessary.
Compliance & Administration
•	Ensure compliance with Fair Work obligations, food safety legislation, workplace health and safety requirements, and Domino's internal compliance policies.
•	Prepare operational reports, sales summaries, labour reports, and performance documentation as required.
•	Maintain accurate records relating to staffing, inventory management, and operational performance.
•	Implement and monitor company policies, procedures, and operational guidelines across all aspects of store management.
•	Support ongoing compliance audits and operational assessments where required.
 
Skills & Experience
Essential Requirements
•	Proven experience in retail or hospitality management within a fast-paced operational environment.
•	Demonstrated leadership capability with experience managing teams, employee rostering, and operational workflows.
•	Strong understanding of inventory management, cost control principles, and retail performance management.
•	Excellent organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
•	Ability to work effectively under pressure while maintaining high service standards.
•	Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required by operational needs.
•	Preference will be given to suitably qualified Australian Citizens and Permanent Residents.
Preferred Qualifications
•	AQF associate degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma (ANZSCO Skill Level 2); or
•	At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualifications listed above. In some instances, relevant experience and/or on-the-job training may be required in addition to formal qualifications.
•	Current Food Safety Certification or willingness to obtain.
•	Previous experience within quick service restaurant (QSR), franchised food retail, or hospitality operations will be highly regarded.
•	Experience using point-of-sale systems, workforce management tools, and inventory management systems is desirable.
Work Environment
The Retail Manager role is highly operational and requires active participation on the shop floor alongside store employees. The position demands excellent time management skills, resilience under pressure, strong leadership capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously within a high-volume service environment. The successful candidate will be expected to lead by example, maintain operational excellence, and contribute positively to the ongoing success of Domino's Pizza Sutherland.

About Us
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory and beyond.

About the Employer
We are supporting an automotive business (ABN 69 669 060 913) based in Acacia Ridge, Queensland, specialising in Japanese vehicle imports, compliance, mechanical repairs, servicing, and vehicle inspections. With over 20 years of industry experience and a commitment to quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The business is seeking a Motor Mechanic to support its growing operations and to maintain, test, diagnose and repair petrol engines and the mechanical components of lightweight motor vehicles, including transmissions, suspension, steering and braking systems.

Salary: $79,423 to $83,000 per annum plus superannuation
Location: Acacia Ridge, QLD
Employment Type: Full-time, ongoing
Ordinary Hours: 38 hours per week

Key Responsibilities
- Detect and diagnose mechanical and related electrical faults in petrol engines and vehicle components.
- Use automotive diagnostic scan tools, computers, multimeters, pressure gauges and other testing equipment to identify faults.
- Inspect and test petrol engines, transmissions, steering systems, suspension systems, brakes and related mechanical components.
- Dismantle and remove engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms and other mechanical components.
- Examine dismantled parts and components for wear, damage, defects and serviceability.
- Repair or replace worn, damaged and defective mechanical parts.
- Reassemble petrol engines and mechanical components following repairs.
- Test and adjust repaired mechanical components to confirm correct operation and performance.
- Perform scheduled maintenance services, including oil and filter changes, lubrication, fluid replacement and engine tune-ups.
- Diagnose and repair fuel, ignition, cooling and engine-management systems.
- Service and repair transmissions, steering, suspension and braking systems.
- Complete vehicle road tests and post-repair inspections.
- Confirm that repairs have been completed correctly and that vehicles operate safely.
- Follow manufacturer specifications, service manuals, technical bulletins and workshop procedures.
- Inspect vehicles for roadworthiness and identify repairs required to meet applicable roadworthiness standards.
- Issue roadworthiness or safety certificates where appropriately licensed or authorised.
- Respond to vehicle breakdown service calls where required.
- Accurately record diagnostic findings, repairs completed, parts used and further work recommended.
- Complete job cards, service records and workshop documentation.
- Safely operate vehicle hoists, mechanical tools, power tools and diagnostic equipment.
- Maintain a clean, safe and organised workshop.
- Comply with workplace health and safety and environmental requirements.
- Assist apprentices or junior workshop employees where reasonably required.

Selection Criteria
1. Light-vehicle mechanical expertise
Demonstrated experience maintaining and repairing petrol-powered passenger and light commercial vehicles.
2. Diagnostic skills
Ability to detect and diagnose mechanical and related electrical faults using automotive diagnostic equipment.
3. Mechanical repair skills
Experience repairing petrol engines, transmissions, brakes, steering and suspension systems.
4. Technical knowledge
Ability to understand and follow manufacturer specifications, service manuals and technical repair information.
5. Problem-solving ability
Ability to identify vehicle faults, determine suitable repair methods and resolve mechanical problems efficiently.
6. Quality workmanship
Strong attention to detail and commitment to completing repairs to an appropriate trade and safety standard.
7. Organisation
Ability to manage allocated workshop jobs, maintain accurate records and complete repairs within required timeframes.
8. Communication and teamwork
Ability to communicate repair findings clearly and work effectively with workshop staff, management and service personnel.
9. Safety awareness
Demonstrated understanding of workshop safety, safe equipment operation and environmentally responsible waste disposal.

Required Qualifications and Experience
- AQF Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology, AQF Certificate IV, or an equivalent recognised automotive mechanical qualification.
- Relevant practical experience servicing and repairing petrol-powered lightweight motor vehicles.
- At least three years of relevant experience
- Experience using automotive diagnostic scan tools and testing equipment.
- Experience diagnosing and repairing petrol engines and associated mechanical systems.
- Current driver licence.
- Ability to work full-time in Brisbane.

How to Apply
We are looking for a reliable, skilled, and safety-minded automotive professional to support vehicle servicing, repairs, inspections, and workshop operations while maintaining high standards of quality, efficiency, and customer service.

To apply, please submit the following:
- Resume outlining your work experience and references.
- A short cover letter of no more than 300 words explaining:
- Why you are applying for this position; and
- An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork. Please use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result.
- A written response of no more than 600 words describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the role. Please structure your example or examples using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a professional and growing automotive business that values quality, safety, teamwork, reliability, and customer satisfaction, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Phone calls and walk-in applications will not be accepted.

Applications Close: 13 August 2026

Job Summary: Lead our SEO & Google Ads team as Head of Digital Marketing with Localsearch  - shape strategy, drive results, and leave your mark on the Gold Coast.

Key Selling Points: 
•	Lead a talented team of SEO & Google Ads strategists in Robina 
•	Report directly to the CEO and shape company-wide strategy 
•	A senior, hands-on leadership role for strategy, people and performance lovers 

Who are we?
At Localsearch, we've been empowering Australian businesses with top-tier digital marketing solutions since 1993. Today, we stand as one of the largest digital marketing powerhouses in Australia, helping over 300,000 businesses grow online. Based in the heart of Robina, just steps from Robina Town Centre, our modern office is equipped with everything you need to thrive - including an on-site café with barista-made coffee, high-tech tools, and a collaborative, fun culture where your skills will shine!

What will you do?
As Head of Digital Marketing, you'll take ownership of Localsearch's SEO and paid search strategy, leading a team of Digital Strategists while reporting directly to our CEO. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives on strategy, people and performance.
•	Develop and implement digital marketing strategies for SEO and paid search, with clearly defined plans and measurable goals
•	Conduct market research and analysis of search behaviour, competitor positioning, and channel trends to inform strategy
•	Advise the CEO on marketing investment priorities, channel mix, and emerging digital opportunities
•	Lead and develop a team of SEO and Google Ads Digital Strategists, setting clear performance expectations
•	Conduct regular one-on-ones and performance reviews to grow individual and team capability
•	Design and oversee digital marketing campaigns across SEO and Google Ads, grounded in audience insight and defined conversion objectives
•	Review and approve campaign strategies to ensure best-practice standards and deliverables are met
•	Oversee the SEO service offering across technical, on-page, content, and link building disciplines
•	Analyse marketing performance across channels, interpreting results against KPIs and presenting recommendations to the CEO
•	Monitor market trends and benchmark performance against industry standards to drive continuous improvement

Who are you & what will you bring?
We're after an experienced digital marketing leader who combines specialist SEO and Google Ads expertise with strong people leadership and commercial acumen.
Required:
•	Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
•	Relevant senior experience in a specialist digital marketing role, with expertise in SEO and paid search, ideally in a digital agency or managed services environment
•	Experience leading and developing a team of digital marketing strategists
•	Experience planning and managing digital marketing campaigns across SEO and paid search for multi-client portfolios
•	Experience conducting market research and using consumer behaviour insights to shape marketing strategy
•	Experience at a senior level with direct engagement with executive leadership
•	Specialist knowledge of SEO and Google Ads
•	Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to coach and hold a team accountable
•	Strong marketing analytics capability, able to interpret data and translate insights into clear recommendations
•	Strong communication skills, able to present complex digital concepts clearly to stakeholders and clients
•	Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities without compromising quality
Nice to have:
•	Google Ads certification
•	Formal training or certification in SEO tools and methodology

Why it's great to work with us!
•	Barista-made coffee daily at our on-site café - because great work deserves great coffee
•	Prime location in Robina, opposite Robina Town Centre, perfect for lunch breaks or errands
•	Fun & supportive culture - we celebrate wins, support each other, and challenge complacency
•	Access to the latest tools & training - stay ahead in the fast-moving world of digital marketing
•	Flexible work-life balance - we know life happens, and we support balance
•	Career growth & mentorship - access our internal mentoring program and upskilling opportunities
•	A comprehensive wellness program supporting mental, financial and physical wellbeing, including free access to an onsite exercise physiologist
•	Employee perks! Paid parental leave, free parking, gym discounts, 24/7 retail discounts and cashback offers, and special rewards for birthdays and tenure
•	We celebrate success BIG! Annual company-wide conference, recognition programs, and team events to reward high performers
